text:
anya: Quick design question — for prompt-sets list + scorecard quick actions. Thinking about keyboard-first flow: when you focus a row and hit Space, the diff panel should open and we should announce which test is selected to screen readers. Screenshot: https://screenshot.redwood.ai/23k (mock)
sam: agree we need an announcement. current markup is a focusable <tr> with role=button which doesn't give a clear announcement. :thinking_face:
kai: could use an aria-live region to announce "Opened diff for <test name>" when the panel opens. keep it polite and brief.
jordan: wary of spamming aria-live on rapid keyboard navigation though. maybe debounce announcements and only announce on open, not on focus.
anya: good point. My proposal: keyboard space toggles panel, focus moves into panel. Add a visually-hidden aria-live="polite" region updated only when panel opens. If user tabs through rows we don't update unless they open.
sam: +1. also need to ensure the quick-approve shortcut (Shift+Enter) is discoverable — maybe a tooltip on focus and a small keyboard hint next to the approve CTA.
kai: tooltip approach is fine, but tooltips aren't great for screen readers. add an accessible hint with aria-describedby pointing to a hidden element that lists shortcuts when row receives focus.
jordan: accessibility nit: confirm the approve button has clear text ("Approve test run") not just an icon. screen reader users otherwise get stuck guessing.
anya: yep will switch to text + icon. UX question: do we show a confirmation toast that is dismissible? we want undo but not modal.
sam: inline snackbar with "Undo" action works. keep it low-contrast enough to not steal focus but programmatically focus the snackbar for keyboard users?
kai: don't steal focus automatically. instead, add an aria-live="assertive" message inside snackbar so assistive tech gets it. only move focus for critical errors.
jordan: mental model sanity check: keyboard users -> focus row -> Space opens diff -> Shift+Enter approves -> snackbar with undo + aria message. sounds good.
anya: i'll mock the changes and post a prototype in Figma. Action items: anya -> update mock, kai -> small a11y PR for aria-live regions and aria-describedby, sam -> add visual keyboard hint copy, jordan -> add snackbar copy + undo behavior spec.
ux-bot: created task PROD-3121 "Prompt-sets: keyboard flow + a11y announces" and linked to Figma file https://figma.com/file/abc123 (assigned to anya)
sam: tiny copy nit for snackbar: use "Approved — Undo" rather than "Approved" so keyboard users see the action verb first.
anya: noted. I'll update and drop the Figma link here when ready. Thanks all :tada!
